mechanics_summary: 200-Stamina Strike Evasive obtained from PQ25, 'The Emperor's Brother.' The user thrusts both arms outward and creates a close-range blue explosion that knocks opponents away; current evidence identifies it as a 360-degree defensive blast and documents that it can be activated while taking damage. Exact invulnerability frames, active duration, damage, and knockback values remain unresolved.
sources: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki skill reference
